name: car-rental-booking-system
description: Sunshine Rentals booking system on MERN stack

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run prod --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
scripts.lint: prettier --check . && npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix backend
scripts.lint:fix: prettier --write . && npm run lint:fix --prefix frontend && npm run lint:fix --prefix backend
scripts.lint:js: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix backend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && CI=true npm test --prefix frontend -- --watchAll=false

author: Sunshine Car Rentals Team
